$comment: Records whose share links preview with a pre-rendered card image on the Workers Free plan (Chiya, Nov 1): the LoRA OOM, and whichever record the X post links. Each card is rendered from the record file named here by `npm run hero-cards` and committed as static/cards/<token>.png. To add one, add its share token as link_id and a copy of its record in the repository.

cards.what: A's Oct 28 L4 run of the LoRA zoo script (a-smoke-l4-main-4): the planted eval OOM caught by probe p1-eval. The file is A's copy of that record with its share token replaced; docs/status/a.md gives the same probe figures.
